retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, glossy 3D aesthetic featuring rounded blob-like characters and heavy extruded typography set against a dark, neon-lit club environment.
excludeWhen: organic or hand-drawn textures are preferred

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, early-digital style defined by smooth, rounded 3D primitives (spheres and ellipsoids) representing characters, paired with aggressive, thick-extruded sans-serif typography. The scene is illuminated by colorful spotlights and a disco ball, creating a high-energy dance floor atmosphere with a distinct plastic-and-chrome material finish.
coreVisualRelationships: Large-scale extruded type dominating the upper third
Centralized 3D character acting as a focal point on a circular stage
Repetitive background crowd elements creating depth
High-contrast interplay between dark backgrounds and saturated red/blue highlights
coreInvariants: Glossy specular highlights on all 3D surfaces
Heavy silver/chrome extrusion on primary text
Circular stage or dance floor motif
Saturated primary red as the dominant subject color

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central 3D character occupies the middle ground, scaled to approximately 40% of the height, positioned on a circular platform.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive, tilted 3D title at the top serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright red title, moves down to the central character's eyes, and then follows the circular stage to the supporting text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is packed with characters and lighting effects to simulate a crowded venue.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Saturated Red (character bodies and text faces)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan/Blue (stage lighting and disco ball reflections)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the foreground elements against low-value, high-contrast backgrounds.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme 3D extrusion with a 45-degree upward tilt
Chrome-textured side faces with horizontal striations
characterSpecificRedesigns: Integration of circular 3D objects (like CDs) into letter counters or as replacements for punctuation
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between massive 3D display type and small, legible, slightly irregular secondary type.

avoid: Flat 2D text for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight for heavy 3D extrusion.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Comic Sans or a rounded marker font
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the playful, informal look of the secondary artist list.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 3D scene of a dark club with a circular blue glowing stage. In the center, place a glossy red character made of smooth ellipsoids wearing headphones. Surround the stage with a crowd of similar smaller red bubble characters. Add a disco ball in the top right and colorful lens flares.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in the top third using an extra-bold sans-serif font with a heavy 3D chrome extrusion and red faces, tilted slightly. Add the secondary text at the bottom in a white, rounded, bold font with a soft drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the main title heavily extruded with a chrome texture?
Are the characters composed of smooth, glossy 3D primitives?
Is the lighting high-contrast with visible lens flares?
Is the color palette dominated by red, blue, and chrome?

mustRedesign: Specific character facial features to avoid direct IP copying
Unique artist names in the secondary text
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent 3D perspective between text and scene
Ensure chrome textures have realistic reflections
Verify that the red color is vibrant and not muddy
Confirm lens flares do not obscure the main text legibility
Check that the character's 'eyes' are expressive and glossy
